diagnosis: The rate-limiter restricts guessing attempts per IP address, but the route queries the PaymentMethod by card_id without scoping to card.customer_id == user.customer_id. An attacker can confirm and activate arbitrary payment instruments belonging to other accounts.

POST /billing/cards/card_9942/verify-microdeposit HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
